scripts.setup:solver: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e "apps/solver[dev]"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:solver
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:solver
scripts.format: prettier --write .prettierrc.json package.json apps/api apps/web && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format apps/solver
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .prettierrc.json package.json apps/api apps/web && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check apps/solver
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:solver
scripts.test:api: npm run test --workspace @academia-espronceda/api -- --runInBand && npm run test:e2e --workspace @academia-espronceda/api -- --runInBand
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
